summary: Test- and docs-only change: one stricter branch in the e2e containment helper (e2e/cards.spec.ts), one new e2e test that mutates the local gallery DOM, one vitest reading README.md, and a README paragraph. No new trust boundary, dependency, secret, permission or randomness. The README points to the existing workflow_dispatch of .github/workflows/visual.yml, which is unchanged: permissions contents: read, and the Playwright version from package-lock.json is regex-validated before it reaches GITHUB_OUTPUT/the Docker image tag. Running it on a Dependabot branch only produces an artifact that a human reviews and commits. The vitest regex is anchored and lazy over a repo-controlled file, so it has no ReDoS path. No findings.
